question: What do entry-level backend developer jobs require?
sources:
[1] Software Developer I - Backend at Electrify America (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-19)
Role Summary
The Backend Developer I will support the development of Electrify America’s back-end systems. The role shall continually develop technology-forward, cutting edge software solutions to address the backend and the downstream systems including website and mobile app goals as well as to create and manage APIs that work across devices, and multiple external partners. The selected candidate will leverage experience to support communication between servers, applications, and databases. Furthermore, the candidate will be proficient at leveraging tools to find, save or change data with the goal to serve it back to the user in front-end code.

[2] Remote Backend Devloper (Golang, Postgres, Python) at Beacon Hill Staffing Group (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-15)
Senior Developer18 month+ contract 100% Remote RolePay: $80/hour PST HOURS REQUIRED MUST INCLUDE CODE SAMPLES / GITHUB WITH SUBMISSION  SummaryJoin us as a Senior Backend Developer, a role where technical expertise and innovative thinking converge.
Be instrumental in designing and optimizing systems, developing integrations, and making complex data accessible and insightful.
With 18 integrated systems and growing, each day presents a new opportunity to refine and expand our datalandscape, encompassing financial metrics, visual effects, and project management insights.
You'll be part of a professional, yet light-hearted team, where each member is valued for their technical contributions and their ability to bring a smile to colleagues' faces-hit us with your best dad joke.

[3] New Grad Back-End Software Engineer at Canoo (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Job Purpose
As a Backend Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the server-side logic and APIs that enable seamless communication between internal systems, IoT devices (electric vehicles), external backend systems, and frontend user interfaces. You will design and implement efficient and scalable backend architectures, ensuring data integrity, security, and high performance. Additionally, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate backend services with frontend applications, providing a seamless user experience across web and mobile platforms.
Responsibilities (80s Of The Position)

Job Title: Java Backend developer Location: Seattle, WA Duration: 8 Months Job Type: Contract Work Type: Onsite/Hybrid  Pay Rate: 60-60/Hourly/W2  Job Description: The Content Platform team is looking for a Software Development Engineer. who will act as first level support and development for all incoming production software application issues dealing with merchandising applications.
Your solutions will impact our customers directly!

Responsibilities also include working alongside development on client Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems.
